title: The Guru's Word, I Meditate On The
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 239
summary: Patience is carried here from through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name toward o Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels impatient, tense, agitated, because it keeps patience inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Patience steadies when o Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan moh param gat paiee ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I have attained the supreme status.
The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan dhiaaio moh naau ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadh moh miliaa thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained a place of rest. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan sun rasan vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: I listen to the Guru's Word, and chant it with my tongue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te a(n)mirat meree baanee ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, my speech is like nectar. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan miTiaa meraa aap ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my selfishness and conceit have been removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee dhiaa te meraa vadd parataap ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's kindness, I have obtained glorious greatness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan miTiaa meraa bharam ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan pekhio sabh braham ||4||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I see God everywhere. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan keeno raaj jog ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I practice Raja Yoga, the Yoga of meditation and success.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sa(n)g tariaa sabh log ||5||
lines.translation: In the Company of the Guru, all the people of the world are saved. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan mere kaaraj sidh ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my affairs are resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan paiaa naau nidh ||6||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, I have obtained the nine treasures. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jin keenee mere gur kee aasaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever places his hopes in my Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee kaTeeaai jam kee faasaa ||7||
lines.translation: has the noose of death cut away. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan jaagiaa meraa karam ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Word, my good karma has been awakened.
O Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God. ||8||8||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: through the Guru's Word, I meditate on the Name.
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside through the Guru's Word, my doubts have been removed.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, meeting with the Guru, I have found the Supreme Lord God.
